## Unobservable on this surface (8)

| Trait | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `BALANCED_CHAMPION` | A championship-season identity. A title is a property of an 82-game season and a bracket, not of a fixed-sample fixture simulation; no surface here observes it. |
| `NON_CHAMPION` | The complement of a championship identity, unobservable for the same reason. |
| `disciplined man` | Discipline names a process quality with no distinguishing observable on this surface: no metric here separates disciplined man defence from ordinary man defence. |
| `disciplined team man` | As for disciplined man: no distinguishing observable. |
| `help-heavy man` | Help frequency is driven by the coach model's coverage selection and has no certified team-level observable; scoring it would grade the coach model against itself. |
| `man with help` | As for help-heavy man. |
| `physical man` | Physicality has no observable on this surface: the engine does not simulate fouls-as-style or bodily contact intensity. |
| `switching small-ball` | Switch rate appears only in rare coverage records driven by the coach model; too sparse to certify, so it is not scored. |
